_instructions: Copy this file to replacements.json, fill every value from the director's answers (see START-HERE.md, step 1). Never put an API key or token in this file. Leave SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID blank if Supabase is not being used. Leave ASANA_BOARD_NAME blank if board-orchestrator is not being used. Leave BROWSER_DEVICE_ID blank; the SIP engines should run without a browser (TROUBLESHOOTING-REPLY.md section F).
FIRST_NAME: <what the team calls them, e.g. David>
SLACK_HANDLE: <their Slack handle without the @, e.g. david.smith>
SLACK_USER_ID: <their Slack member id, starts with U>
SLACK_SELF_DM_ID: <the channel id of their own self-DM, starts with D>
TTW_EMAIL: <their @ttwhizprogram.com Google account, or blank if same as WFS_EMAIL>
